body_non_sensitive.prompt: 白色背景，左侧一个红色圆形，右侧一个蓝色正方形，无文字。

step_A_image_generation.size_rationale: 16:9 for later video first-frame layout; area 589,824 px within 512x512..2048x2048 and within 1k billing tier (<=2,250,000 px); lowest-cost tier

verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.PASS: HTTP 200 with data[0].url; real image downloaded (not URL-only); file non-empty; decodable by PIL; format/actual size/bytes/SHA-256 recorded; pixel stats recorded (left-half red dominant, right-half blue dominant, white background)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.FAIL: HTTP error / error object / download or decode failure / returned payload is not a valid image
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.UNKNOWN: timeout, auth error, or ambiguous transport failure (recorded distinctly)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.content_match: separate recorded field from pixel statistics; content mismatch does not silently pass as capability PASS, it is carried into B/C interpretation

step_B_image_edit.input: A downloaded real PNG as single reference image (data URL base64)

body_non_sensitive.prompt: 保持白色背景和左右布局，将左侧红色圆形改成绿色，右侧蓝色正方形保持不变。

verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.PASS: HTTP 200 with data[0].url; real edited image downloaded and decodable; pixel stats show edit took effect: left-half green dominant AND red strongly reduced vs A, right-half blue retained, background white; single reference image accepted (usage.input_image_count == 1)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.FAIL: HTTP error, decode failure, or edited image content contradicts the edit instruction (left not turned green / layout destroyed)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.note: verifies ViMax-needed reference-image editing for ONE image only; no claim about multi-image consistency

step_C_chat_vision_tool_call.input_image: B downloaded real PNG (base64 data URL)

content.text: 识别这张图片，并通过工具提交结果。图片中左侧和右侧各有一个图形，请用 report_shapes 工具报告它们的颜色和形状。

function.name: report_shapes
function.description: 报告图片左右两侧图形的颜色与形状

step_C_chat_vision_tool_call.enable_thinking_note: forced tool choice is not supported in thinking mode per official docs; enable_thinking=false is the documented non-thinking mode for qwen3.7-plus

expected_answer_pre_registered.basis: B edit target; cross-checked offline against B actual pixels before judging C

verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.PASS: HTTP 200; finish_reason == tool_calls; tool_calls[0].id non-empty; function.name == report_shapes; arguments is valid JSON; all four fields parse to enum values and match the pre-registered answer (color words mapped: 绿/green, 蓝/blue, 红/red; 圆/circle, 方/square; English or Chinese both accepted)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.FAIL: tool call present but a parsed field is clearly wrong, or model states it cannot process the image
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.UNKNOWN: no tool call / unparseable arguments / timeout / auth / transport failure; if B's actual pixels contradict the pre-registered answer (image-generation deviation), C vision judgement is UNKNOWN rather than FAIL unless mismatch with actual image content is established
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.not_retested: tool result round-trip (sending tool message back) is NOT performed this round; listed as not re-verified
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.field_note: usage and image-related fields saved in full; missing image_tokens field does NOT prove the image was not passed

input.prompt: 固定机位，左侧绿色圆形缓慢上下移动，右侧蓝色正方形保持静止；背景纯白；全程单镜头，无文字。
input.img_url: <B.png base64 data URL as FIRST FRAME>

step_D_video_create_poll_download.shot_type_note: shot_type only takes effect when prompt_extend=true per official docs; prompt_extend=false -> shot_type omitted; single-shot requirement is expressed in the prompt text
step_D_video_create_poll_download.img_url_note: img_url is the real first-frame field of the i2v API (not a generic reference image, not t2v)
step_D_video_create_poll_download.poll_policy: max 40 polls, target 10 s interval, always bounded by the shared 1200 s deadline; only this one task is queried; never create a second task

verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.CREATE_PASS: HTTP 200 + output.task_id + task_status in (PENDING, RUNNING); task_id saved
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.VIDEO_PASS: task SUCCEEDED within budget; video downloaded; ffprobe shows valid MP4/H.264, ~16:9 within 720P tier, duration ~5 s, no audio track (audio=false); decodes fully; extracted frames show motion (frame difference > 0) and left-green/right-blue layout not obviously deviated
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.VIDEO_FAIL: task FAILED or downloaded media fails technical checks or layout/colors clearly contradicted
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.VIDEO_UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT: polls/deadline exhausted while task still PENDING/RUNNING; task_id + last status preserved; note that remote task may keep running and may still incur cost; no claim that the remote task was cancelled (cancel API not verified)
verdict_rules_fixed_pre_send.no_quality_claim: successful MP4 download does NOT assert motion correctness beyond frame-difference evidence; no strict video quality scoring is claimed

media_technical_checks.images: PIL decode; actual size/format/bytes/SHA-256; pixel statistics per half-region (dominant color share) as human-checkable evidence
media_technical_checks.video: ffprobe codec/size/fps/duration/audio streams; full decode via ffmpeg null muxer; 3+ extracted frames; first-vs-last frame pixel difference; color/layout stats on extracted frames

counting_and_timing.boundary: counts increment at the actual HTTP send function entry (model ops, create, poll, download), persisted even on exception paths
counting_and_timing.caveats: client observation only; gateway/upstream internal retries unknowable; if transport-layer counting is impossible the HTTP count is marked unknown rather than replaced by logical op count

no_record: full signed URL (query string stripped in evidence)
security.media_download: official media URLs downloaded WITHOUT the model API Authorization header; separate no-auth client
security.limits: per-request timeouts, download size caps (image 20 MB, video 200 MB), shared 1200 s deadline
